title: How many hours did a German work in 1870, compared with today?
subtitle: Two hosts, one bar to drag: guess how long Germans worked in 1870, then see what cut the hours by sixty percent, and who works least today.
notes: y axis fixed at 5,000 so it does not hint the 1870 bar. Twist shown as a scratch card of 2023 hours (South Korea, USA, Germany lowest of all countries in the data). Text in data units on a bar chart is hard to place (anchoring unclear).
